original_target.title: Competitive exclusion in a chemostat with unequal removal rates

verification: Literature and theorem-scope review; no independent whole-proof or Lean verification.
queries: "chemostat" "unequal removal" site:zenodo.org OR site:hal.science OR site:github.com

sources.scope: Small mass-conserving species-exchange perturbations of common dilution, compact-initial-set dependent threshold.
General monotone response with unequal removal remains exact posed problem.

registry_checks: Palomar chemostat match is a reaction-network affinity counterexample with a different model; Hexagon no matching metadata. Focused scholarly, author, Zenodo, HAL and GitHub searches.
scope_comparison: Target is all finite n, all increasing C1 gross-growth laws, independent arbitrary removal constants and all positive populations. Small conservative conversion cannot absorb arbitrary independent removals. Stochastic/viral, allelopathic and internal-storage variants add terms absent from the target.
rationale: Bounded searches found no full matching resolution or announcement. Current perturbation theorem and different-model counterexamples do not settle this target.
